all.text: At this latitude, the Earth's spin carries the ship east at about 780 mph, whatever the captain is doing.
The sun reaches its highest point here about 41 minutes after it does in Southampton.
Drill straight through the Earth from here and you'd surface at 41.5°S, 168.4°E, about 420 km from Christchurch.
This far north, they're roughly level with Chicago, even though it's a world away.
The seabed is roughly 3,411 m below the ship, which is about 10.3 Eiffel Towers stacked up.
